name: A Donation of Mageweave
label: Quest
description: A Donation of Mageweave: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Mageweave is running low, and we could use your help to replenish our stocks! By counting on the community as a whole, we would only need a donation of 60 pieces of mageweave cloth from you to enable us to reach our goal. Such generosity would not go unnoticed by Darnassus, I assure you!
If you have the sixty pieces of mageweave cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, friend!
